settings.dateFormat: not set: GnuCash's default, locale, which under C is %m/%d/%y; no check reads a date

book: adjusting-entries.gnucash (same GUIDs) with the two foreign transfers the test adds before its last run (:170-173): 2000-01-15 GBP Bank to Bank, GBP 10 for USD 14 "GBP 10 to USD 14"; 2000-02-15 Bank to GBP Bank, USD 9 for GBP 8 "USD 9 to GBP 8". Each adds a price that replaces create-test-data's of the same pair, day and source (5.17:libgnucash/engine/gnc-pricedb.cpp:1053-1071): USD in GBP 10/14 on 2000-01-15 (equal), and GBP in USD 9/8 on 2000-02-15 (was 9/6), now the only GBP price in USD. Own balances: Bank $2,191, GBP Bank #606; the others as in adjusting-entries.gnucash.
optionValues: Options are those changed from the template's defaults and in effect for the run: the test changes one options object step by step, so the run keeps the earlier runs' changes (adjusting-entries.expected.json) and sets the variation back to current, the default (:175). {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight. Symbols are written without the quote.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table 1 of the document; row N counts <tr> elements from 1, negative from the end; column null every cell. The result is every text node in document order.
